-- Conquest of Azeroth clients list extra map files (starting-area, cave and custom
-- zone maps, often lowercased). Resolve them from the client's own WorldMapArea
-- data first, then by case-insensitive match against the stock names.
local function FindZoneData(continent, zoneData, mapName)
	local data = zoneData[mapName]
	if data or type(mapName) ~= "string" then return data end
	local lowered = mapName:lower()
	local coa = ZygorAstrolabeCoAZoneData and ZygorAstrolabeCoAZoneData[continent]
	if coa and coa[lowered] then
		Astrolabe.UsesCoAZoneData = true -- lets the rest of the addon know it runs on a CoA client
		return coa[lowered]
	end
	for name, candidate in pairs(zoneData) do
		if type(name) == "string" and name:lower() == lowered then return candidate end
	end
end

-- CoA fix: a kill-credit objective's IdList can hold nested id lists (and its Id then is a table too), so
-- comparing an entry with 0 failed with "attempt to compare number with table". Flatten to positive numbers.
local function _PositiveNumericIds(list, out, depth)
    out, depth = out or {}, depth or 0
    for _, id in ipairs(list) do
        if type(id) == "number" then
            if id > 0 then out[#out + 1] = id end
        elseif type(id) == "table" and depth < 2 then
            _PositiveNumericIds(id, out, depth + 1)
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- CoA fix: Auto mode used to swap the database spawns for the learned ones, so a couple of kills left only the
-- places you had killed at on the map. Returns a copy of spawns with the learned points added; a learned point
-- within 2 map units of one already in that zone is left out, so kills next to a database spawn don't double it.
local function _AddLearnedSpawns(spawns, learnedSpawns)
    local merged = {}
    for zoneId, coords in pairs(spawns or {}) do
        if type(coords) == "table" then
            local list = {}
            for i = 1, #coords do
                list[i] = coords[i]
            end
            merged[zoneId] = list
        end
    end
    for zoneId, coords in pairs(learnedSpawns) do
        if type(coords) == "table" then
            local list = merged[zoneId] or {}
            merged[zoneId] = list
            for _, coord in ipairs(coords) do
                local x = type(coord) == "table" and tonumber(coord[1])
                local y = type(coord) == "table" and tonumber(coord[2])
                if x and y then
                    local near = false
                    for _, other in ipairs(list) do
                        local ox = type(other) == "table" and tonumber(other[1])
                        local oy = type(other) == "table" and tonumber(other[2])
                        if ox and oy and math.abs(ox - x) < 2 and math.abs(oy - y) < 2 then
                            near = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not near then
                        list[#list + 1] = coord
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return merged
end
